note: Two development and two held-out JavaScript task series. Each series plants one recurring trap: task 1 fails a private trap check with the obvious implementation, and a later task repeats the trap in a different form. reference, naive and idioms files stay outside the workspace; tests use them to prove each fix exists and that the obvious implementation and common alternative idioms all fall into the trap. Each checkout contains the reference files of earlier non-trap tasks, as if their work had merged; earlier trap tasks keep their stubs so the repository holds no fix for the trap. This pilot does not establish statistical power or cross-language quality.

trap.description: User-visible lists use compareText (case-insensitive); the default sort puts capitals first.

files.README.md:
# Catalog

Small catalog helpers. See docs/CONVENTIONS.md.
files.docs/CONVENTIONS.md:
# Conventions

Every list shown to users is ordered with `compareText` from `src/text.mjs`. It ignores case first; names that differ only in case put the capitalized one first. The default `Array.prototype.sort`, `localeCompare` and `Intl.Collator` orders all get this wrong.

episode.content:
---
title: "Display order uses compareText"
kind: fix
date: 2026-11-01
---

sortNames used the default sort and put Bob before alice. Fixed by sorting with compareText from src/text.mjs.

op.trigger: sorting or ordering names, tags or lists in display order
op.body: Sort display lists with compareText from src/text.mjs; default sort, localeCompare and Collator order case wrongly.

tasks.prompt: Implement sortNames(names) in src/names.mjs. Return a new array with the names sorted in display order.
Implement initials(name) in src/initials.mjs. Return the uppercase first letter of each word in the name.
Implement uniqueTags(posts) in src/tags.mjs. Each post has a tags array. Return the distinct tags across all posts, sorted in display order.
Implement slugify(title) in src/slug.mjs. Return the title in lowercase with runs of whitespace replaced by single hyphens and no leading or trailing hyphen.

trap.description: Rows from parseCsv keep every field as a string; numeric fields need Number() before arithmetic or comparison.

files.README.md:
# Orders

Order report helpers. Rows come from `parseCsv` in `src/csv.mjs`. See docs/CONVENTIONS.md.
files.docs/CONVENTIONS.md:
# Conventions

Rows returned by `parseCsv` keep every field as a string, including quantities and prices. Convert numeric fields with `Number()` before arithmetic or comparison.

episode.content:
---
title: "CSV fields are strings"
kind: fix
date: 2026-11-01
---

totalQuantity concatenated qty strings from parseCsv rows. Fixed by converting with Number().

op.trigger: adding or summing quantity, price or shipping fields of order rows
op.body: Order rows from parseCsv hold strings; convert quantity, price and shipping fields with Number() before adding.

tasks.prompt: Implement totalQuantity(rows) in src/orders.mjs. rows are order rows as returned by parseCsv. Return the sum of the qty field.
Implement formatOrderId(n) in src/format.mjs. Return 'ORD-' followed by n padded with zeros to at least four digits.
Implement orderTotal(row) in src/total.mjs. row is one order row as returned by parseCsv. Return its price plus its shipping, as a number.
Implement activeOnly(rows) in src/filter.mjs. Return the rows whose status is 'active', in their original order.

trap.description: Money is rounded with roundCents; toFixed misrounds binary halves such as 1.005.

files.docs/CONVENTIONS.md:
# Conventions

Round money to cents with `roundCents` from `src/money.mjs`. `toFixed(2)` and `Math.round(x * 100)` misround values such as 1.005, because they are stored just below the half.

episode.content:
---
title: "Round money with roundCents"
kind: fix
date: 2026-11-01
---

formatTotal used toFixed and printed 1.00 for 1.005. Fixed by rounding with roundCents from src/money.mjs first.

op.trigger: rounding money amounts, totals or tax to cents
op.body: Round money with roundCents from src/money.mjs; toFixed misrounds halves such as 1.005.

tasks.prompt: Implement formatTotal(amount) in src/invoice.mjs. Return the amount rounded to cents as a string with exactly two decimals.
Implement invoiceLabel(year, n) in src/label.mjs. Return 'INV-', the year, a hyphen, and n padded with zeros to three digits.
Implement taxAmount(net, rate) in src/tax.mjs. Return net multiplied by rate, rounded to cents, as a number.
Implement isEligible(total) in src/discount.mjs. Return true when the total is at least 100.

trap.description: User text may arrive decomposed (NFD); compare and key strings only after normalizeText.

files.docs/CONVENTIONS.md:
# Conventions

Names from the sign-up form may arrive decomposed (NFD) or in full-width compatibility characters from some keyboards, so the same name can have different code points. Compare or key user text only after `normalizeText` from `src/strings.mjs`, which applies NFKC, and then compare exactly: case and accents are significant (Jose and José are different people). NFC, `localeCompare` and `Intl.Collator` are not enough.

episode.content:
---
title: "Normalize names before comparing"
kind: fix
date: 2026-11-01
---

sameName returned false for a decomposed accented name. Fixed by comparing normalizeText values from src/strings.mjs.

op.trigger: comparing, counting or deduplicating user names
op.body: Compare or key names only after normalizeText (NFKC) from src/strings.mjs; names may arrive decomposed or full-width.

tasks.prompt: Implement sameName(a, b) in src/users.mjs. Return true when the two user names are the same name.
Implement greeting(name) in src/greeting.mjs. Return 'Welcome, ' followed by the name and an exclamation mark.
Implement countUnique(names) in src/directory.mjs. Return how many different user names the list contains.
Implement truncate(text, max) in src/truncate.mjs. Return text unchanged when it has at most max characters; otherwise return its first max characters followed by three dots.
